claims.text: A 60-second apnea event was detected in recording c02 starting at 2000-01-05T08:15:00+00:00 and ending at 2000-01-05T08:16:00+00:00, corresponding to window index 495.
The detector flagged this window as an anomaly with a reconstruction error of 3.928, exceeding the threshold of 3.521; the anomaly margin was 0.408 and the normalized margin was 0.116.
The model used is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (version apnea-05-c02_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset, with the test patient being c02.
No signal-level or attention-level evidence was available for this window; therefore, no channel-specific or temporal relevance information is provided.
The current event is supported by detector evidence indicating an anomaly, but no signal or attention details are available to further characterize the window.
